subject: Re: Demo planning — Northbridge platform priorities shifting
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lily Wong <lily.wong@northbridge.io>, Connor Park <connor.park@northbridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo planning — Northbridge platform priorities shifting

Hi Lily / Connor,

Thanks for the time last week — great to hear about the analytics pipeline you’re building. Per our discussion I put together a 30-minute demo focused on inference economics (latency, cost, and reliability) and a short agenda attached.

Proposed times:
- Thu Jun 17, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Fri Jun 18, 11:00–11:30 PT

If those don’t work tell me a couple windows and I’ll book. We’ll cover: quick walkthrough, typical performance profiles, and a short Q&A about Dedicated vs Hosted.

Agenda: demo-agenda.pdf (attached)

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Eng, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Lily Wong <lily.wong@northbridge.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor Park <connor.park@northbridge.io>
Date: 2026-06-11T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo planning — Northbridge platform priorities shifting

Hi Mina,

Appreciate the follow-up and the agenda. Quick update from our side — the execs just reprioritized our roadmap for Q3. The data team is pulling most of our engineering capacity into a platform migration (data lake + analytical engine). That means we need to deprioritize the LLM/inference work for the next 6–8 weeks.

Can we pause scheduling for now? We still want to evaluate Redwood, but we’ll likely be ready to revisit after the migration kickoff (aiming for early August).

If it helps, please keep us on a short nurture cadence — a month-to-month check is fine, or a brief note when you have a new quantized model demo or a case study that’s relevant.

— Lily
Lily Wong, Director of Data Platforms
Northbridge Analytics
lily.wong@northbridge.io
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lily Wong <lily.wong@northbridge.io>
Cc: Connor Park <connor.park@northbridge.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-11T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo planning — Northbridge platform priorities shifting

Hi Lily — thanks for the context and congrats on the platform migration (big project!). Totally understand needing to pull capacity.

A couple quick options so we don’t lose momentum:
1) Waitlist: I’ll mark this deal for Q3 follow-up and set a reminder to reach back out in early August.
2) Light touch nurture: I can send a one-page note monthly with product updates and a short case study relevant to data-platform teams.
3) Quick async: if it’s helpful I can send a 6-minute recorded demo focused on where teams see the biggest cost wins with prefix/KV caching.

We can also offer a short pilot credit if Northbridge wants to run a small smoke test once you have a free sprint. No pressure — just options so you have something to pick up when you’re ready.

Which do you prefer?

Thanks,
Mina
Senior Solutions Eng, Redwood Inference

On a separate note Marissa — cc’ing you to flag RD-2026-1023 for nurture and to confirm whether we should apply a pilot credit entitlement if they ask once the migration settles.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-12T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo planning — Northbridge platform priorities shifting

Thanks for the flag, Mina.

Please add RD-2026-1023 to the nurture queue and set the HubSpot task for 2026-08-03. If they ask for a pilot credit, authorize up to $2k in cloud credits and coordinate with Aditya for any pricing notes. Keep the monthly one-pagers short (product highlight + relevant customer result) — they perform better for platform teams.

Also add a HubSpot note: "Prospect deprioritized; focus shifted to data platform migration; follow-up early Aug. Mission: maintain lightweight engagement, avoid aggressive outreach."

— Marissa
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lily Wong <lily.wong@northbridge.io>
Cc: Connor Park <connor.park@northbridge.io>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo planning — Northbridge platform priorities shifting

Hi Lily — thanks for confirming. We’ll pause active scheduling and I’ve set a follow-up for the week of Aug 3. I’ll send a brief product note on July 1 and a short recorded demo we can reuse when you’re ready.

If anything changes sooner (window opens, or you want the recorded demo now) just reply and I’ll move quickly.

Best of luck with the migration — reach out if triage questions come up around inference tradeoffs during the platform work.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Eng, Redwood Inference
